conditions: a represented source domain and target domain are compared under candidate object-node correspondences
candidate transferable predicates are selected from the represented structural relations rather than by domain-specific semantic content
task: derive a target-domain interpretation and candidate inferences from a cross-domain structural comparison
temporal_scope: object correspondences need not be fixed before relational matching begins, but must be settled before relational mapping is finished

nodes.description: source-side represented system containing object nodes, unary attributes, and inter-object relations
target-side represented system into which selected source structure is carried
pairing or substitution relation between source-side and target-side object nodes
unary predicates attached to individual represented objects
predicates relating two or more represented objects or propositions
interconnected system in which higher-order predicates link and organize lower-order relations
subset of source-side relational predicates preferentially retained for transfer
candidate propositions generated in the target representation by carrying selected source predicates across the object-node substitutions

relations.description: source-side object nodes are paired with target-side object nodes through correspondence substitutions
the interpretation rule preferentially carries inter-object relations while excluding object-specific unary attributes from the transferred structure
a relation that belongs to a mutually interconnected higher-order system is more likely to be retained than an isolated relation
selected source relations are carried into the target using the established object substitutions, producing candidate target inferences
